diagnosis: Customer reports ~40 missed webhook deliveries during a one-hour window yesterday. Failed deliveries retry automatically; events remain manually replayable for seven days, so replay is still possible.
reply: Thanks for the report. Failed webhook deliveries automatically retry six times over roughly an hour; after that, any undelivered events remain available for manual replay for seven days. Your missed events from yesterday are within that window, so you can replay them from your webhook settings. If you run into issues while replaying or find events you can't recover, let us know and we'll take a closer look.
